definition.note: No (g, dh) pair is stored: not a closed-form expression: phi (_atower_phi) is an algorithm, not a single closed-form expression (call to unknown min()). The shipped implementation is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: R. Schoen / Lopez & Ros (1991) on the Lopez-Ros deformation; H. F. Scherk (1835) for the base Scherk surface; the decorated-Enneper symmetrization follows M. Weber's repository, https://minimalsurfaces.blog/ (Enneper with n Catenoids).

cross_checked.source: H. Karcher, Manuscripta Math. 62 (1988); J. Perez, M. Traizet, Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 359 (2007) 965-990 (minsurf ch140)
cross_checked.detail: 'Hermann Karcher's Scherk Towers are translation invariant minimal surface with genus 0 in the quotient'; Perez-Traizet: 'the only singly periodic minimal surfaces of genus 0 with annular ends.'
